title: Root cause: dup_clear_denoms returns unstripped [EX(0)] for zero poly; DMP.is_zero (dmp_zero_p) then wrongly returns False; terms_gcd crashes on unstripped zero
evidence_refs: repro run: bad_poly.rep=[EX(0)], is_zero=False, terms_gcd IndexError

title: Root cause proven: dup_clear_denoms returns unstripped [EX(0)] for a zero poly; dmp_zero_p then says is_zero=False and dmp_terms_gcd crashes with IndexError

Cause found: EX.__bool__ uses structural 'f.ex != 0'; the constant zero expr is structurally nonzero, so dup_strip keeps rep [EX(expr)] and dup_mul_ground leaves [EX(0)] unstripped → is_zero False, terms_gcd IndexError. Upstream fix (PR #20428): __bool__ = not f.ex.is_zero
evidence_refs: upstream: git show cb21c7719c = PR #20428 one-liner in expressiondomain.py
repro: bad_poly rep [EX(0)], is_zero False, terms_gcd IndexError

title: Fixed: EX.__bool__ now uses not f.ex.is_zero; clear_denoms() zero poly is properly stripped — is_zero True, terms_gcd/primitive work, matches upstream PR #20428
